entities.summary: Rolf Lennart Johansson was a Swedish ice hockey defender. He was a key figure in Brynäs IF, winning seven national titles as a player and then one as a coach in 1980. Internationally he competed only at the 1964 Winter Olympics, where he won a silver medal.
